Meta.description: {site} — private by default, in English, German and French.

Footer.label: About this site
Footer.note: Developed in public. Inspect the work and follow its progress.

Home.waiting: is waiting for its first page.
Home.lede: Everything underneath already runs: accounts, languages, security and the pipeline that ships each change. What is missing is the part only its owner can decide — what this should say, and who it should say it to.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: No real name needed, no trackers, and nothing you write leaves this site unless you send it.

accounts.title: Your way in
accounts.body: A password, a passkey, a link by email — or one click with an account you already have.

languages.title: Three languages
languages.body: English, German and French, chosen from your browser and switchable on every page.

Home.widget: You can also change it from here. Point at anything on this page, say what is wrong, and it becomes a pull request — the same one an agent would open.

Auth.signUpLede: No real name needed. Choose whatever way in suits you; you can add more later.
Auth.withSignin: Continue with Google, Apple, GitHub, X or Facebook
Auth.withLink: Email me a sign-in link instead
Auth.signUpWithLink: Sign up with a link by email instead
Auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A long phrase is easier to remember than symbols.
Auth.displayNameHint: Optional. Anything you like — it does not have to be your real name.
Auth.checkInbox: We sent a link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue. It works for 10 minutes.
Auth.confirmInbox: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address and finish creating your account.
Auth.totpPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Auth.backupPrompt: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-factor sign-in.
Auth.unavailable: Accounts are not switched on for this site yet. Everything that does not need an account still works.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Accounts are not available right now. Try again in a little while.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again, or choose another way to sign in.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: That email and password do not match. Check both, or sign in with a link instead.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address first — the link is in your inbox.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: There is already an account with this address. Sign in instead.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL: There is already an account with this address. Sign in instead.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The password can have at most 128 characters.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: That does not look like an email address.
errors.INVALID_CODE: That code is not right, or it has expired. Try the newest one.
errors.INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_CODE: That code is not right, or it has expired. Try the newest one.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: For your safety, sign in again before changing this.

Account.title: Your account
Account.noEmail: none — add a password sign-in to use email
Account.passkeysLede: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password.
Account.twoFactorOn: On. Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
Account.twoFactorOff: Off. Turn it on to ask for a code from an authenticator app at every sign-in.
Account.currentPasswordHint: Needed if your account has a password. Without one, sign in again first.
Account.scan: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
Account.backupCodes: Keep these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone.
Account.deleteConfirm: To delete your account and everything in it, type {word}

errors.model: That key cannot use this model. Choose one from the list.
errors.save: The key could not be saved. Check it and try again.
